items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...If he'd worked for Captain Perrin or Tasso. ... And of course that would be Emil Tasso, I guess. [INTERVIEWEE] Emil Tasso, yeah.

ctx.x: The reason I asked about Geordie was according to the Prelude magazine, he said your sister played with Stratacos and Hal Geordie, both of them. But you might not have ever gotten a chance to hear them. You know, I'd go back and look at, you know, his father wrote for the Union magazine. And he'd tell about, every contract would be listed. If he'd worked for Captain Perrin or Tasso. I don't know who Captain Perrin was, but they'd have that name in the Union book. And of course that would be Emil Tasso, I guess.
And the Musicians Ball, it tells about how he'd work on that reception committee. Did you go to those balls when they happened?
